decisions.statement: One fold over every line builds the entries rather than gathering results first.
A resumed read and a read from the first byte end at the same entries.
A result arriving after its call is written into the entry already emitted.
A call emitted after its result reads that result off the state the fold has.
A result answers every place a tool use id was emitted rather than the last.
A line is folded like every other line and then taken back rather than held out.
A journal is undone from its last note backwards.
The earliest note kept for one key is the note that holds.
A list of emit sites is copied into the journal rather than held.
Results are taken from every record whatever the record's type.
Only a user record or an assistant record with no meta mark becomes an entry.
A tool's subject is one line of at most 200 characters.

definition: the entries a transcript's lines fold into
